failure_analysis.symptom: Pytest executed 1814 tests across ~11m42s in scripts/ and services/. 1813 passed, but 1 test failed: scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py::test_compose_operator_bff_wires_owner_service_jwt_credentials.
failure_analysis.mechanism: DEV-COMPOSE-JWT-FAIL-CLOSED-20261008 removed published default credentials (pantheon-local-capital-jwt-secret, pantheon-local-registry-jwt-secret, pantheon-local-governance-jwt-secret) across all service blocks in docker-compose.yml so all JWT secrets fail closed when unset. However, scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py in test_compose_operator_bff_wires_owner_service_jwt_credentials still contained hardcoded assertions expecting the old published literal defaults (e.g., assert operator_bff_env['PANTHEON_CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET'] == '${PANTHEON_CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-${CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-pantheon-local-capital-jwt-secret}}'). When .github/workflows/persona-owner-contract.yml ran against PR #6385 (triggered because docker-compose.yml was modified), the assertion failed: AssertionError: assert '${PANTHEON_CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-${CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-${PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-}}}' == '${PANTHEON_CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-${CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET:-pantheon-local-capital-jwt-secret}}'.
